verdict.rationale: Restate's first-party docs describe this story directly: completed steps are stored in an execution log via `ctx.run`, and code resumes where it left off after failures, including infrastructure crashes [restate-docs-1, restate-docs-18, restate-docs-82]. State persists with strong consistency and survives crashes, restarts and infrastructure changes [restate-docs-2, restate-docs-60, restate-docs-48], and immutable deployments keep in-flight retries on the same version across deploys [restate-docs-24, restate-docs-41]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of crash/deploy recovery (community comments do not test resume behavior).
